-BOBBIE TROUT-
-HONOLULU TO LOS ANGELES-
-SOLO (ALONE) OCEAN FLIGHT-
To all our Philatelic Friends,
Greetings!
The management of this flight wishes to bring to your attention an important
decision affecting the prices of Covers relating to Miss Trout's Solo Ocean
Flight.
As we're all friends, we might just as well tell the truth.
We were
under the impression that five dollars was not too much to ask for the three
covers connected with this flight. We thought that if a girl had the nerve to
risk her life by flying across
an ocean, alone, five dollars a set was little
enough.
However, thousands of collectors have written us suggesting that it was
too much; and that one dollar would suit them for the cover to be carried by
Miss Trout and fifty cents a piece for the two commemorating her departure and
arrival. Inasmuch as this department is in the hands of a real Philatelist, we
put it up to him and his reply was,
"I'd stand by the bunch". Accordingly,
from
now on the price of Bobbie Trout's Special Cover is one dollar and the other two,
fifty cents each.
Take your pick. Another nice thing to know is this--We are
returning three dollars to all those who paid five dollars, the original price,
so as to be fair to one and all. Here are the conditions under which you
buy covers:
Cover #1 - A special cachet cover to be carried by Miss Trout will be auto-
graphed in her own handwriting and will be post-marked 'Honolulu' the day of her
departure for Los Angeles.
Upon her arrival in Los Angeles it will again be
stamped and post-marked, then forwarded to the addressed.
Price--one dollar.
Cover #2 - You send us this cover, self-addressed and stamped. Miss Trout
will apoly a special cachet autograph to it and mail it to you from Honolulu the
day of her departure.
Price - fifty cents.
Cover #3 - This cover is also mailed to us by you. Miss Trout will autograph
it, apply a special cachet, and, upon her arrival from overseas, it will be mailed
to you.
Price - fifty cents.
Cashiers' checks or postal money orders must be made out to the order of the
Bobbie Trout Fund and sent direct to Mr. Earl Mills, 750 North Hayworth Avenue,
Hollywood, California.
It is specifically understood by the purchaser of said
Covers that, owing to the hazards attendant upon this flight, responsibility for
the return of covers and fees received is not assumed by the Bobbie Trout Fund
(comorising Miss Bobbie Trout, Pilot: Gordon S. Davidson, Director of Flight; and
Mr. Earl Mills, sole agent for said Cachet Covers). However, every precaution
will be taken to assure the purchasers of the safe return of
the covers, and, in
the event that any unforeseen circumstances render it imoossible for this flight
to be started, all monies will be refunded to purchaser less cost of postage.
